units.source: 以下为本阶段发现的关键风险，均源自台湾团队遗留代码。按影响优先级排列，营收阻断类问题优先处理。
units.target: The following are the key risks identified in this phase, all stemming from legacy code left by the Taiwan team. Priorities are based on impact; revenue-blocking issues take precedence.

units.source: 【营收风险·已处理】专属IP付款完全失效
units.target: Revenue Risk Resolved: Complete Failure of Exclusive IP Payments

units.source: 台湾遗留代码缺陷导致每笔专属IP购买均以失败告终，该品类自上线起即零收入。若未发现，用户投诉将在正式上线后集中爆发，影响应用评分与用户留存。团队发现后当天完成定位与修复，目前正在全流程测试验证中。
units.target: Legacy code defects in Taiwan's team caused every exclusive IP purchase to fail. Since launch, this category has generated no revenue. If not identified, user complaints will concentrate after the official release, impacting application ratings and user retention. The issue was located and fixed on the same day; it is currently undergoing full lifecycle testing.

units.source: 【营收风险·修复中】付款页面未自动关闭——重复扣款隐患
units.target: Revenue Risk Under Repair: Unautomated Payment Page - Repeated Deduction Hazard

units.source: 用户完成付款后，支付页面偶尔不会自动关闭。若用户误触重试，存在重复发起支付的风险。修复方案本周已启动，预计本阶段内完成验证。
units.target: Users occasionally encounter issues where the payment page does not automatically close after completing a transaction. If users mistakenly retry, there is a risk of duplicate payments. The fix has been initiated and is expected to be completed within this sprint.

units.source: 【安全风险·已处理】免费节点流量被大规模滥用——多层防护体系已建立
units.target: 【Security Risks · Resolved】Free VPN node Traffic Being Abused on a Large Scale — A Multi-Layered Protection System Has Been Established

units.source: 台湾遗留系统允许同一设备通过多次注册无限重置每日免费额度，并可被模拟器自动批量注册。若不处理，随规模增长，带宽成本将持续被无转化价值的滥用流量侵蚀，付费用户连接质量也随之下降。
units.target: The Taiwan legacy system allows devices to register multiple times, resetting daily free quotas indefinitely, and can be automatically registered in bulk by simulators. If not addressed, as the scale grows, bandwidth costs will continue to be eroded by non-revenue-generating traffic, leading to a decline in paid user experience.

units.source: 本阶段建立了五层防护机制（验证中），
units.target: This Sprint established a five-layer protection mechanism (under review).

units.target: After reinstalling the app, users return to their original account and do not receive a new quota.

units.source: 卸载重装刷新试用资格
units.target: Refresh trial eligibility after uninstalling and reinstalling.

units.source: 应用启动时检测模拟器环境，直接拦截注册
units.target: Simulator environment check at application startup, directly intercepts registration.

units.source: 模拟器自动批量注册账号工厂
units.target: Automated batch account creation in the simulator factory.

units.target: Each IP can register up to 5 new accounts per day

units.source: 每台设备最多绑定3个账号
units.target: Up to 3 accounts can be bound per device

units.source: 【稳定性·已处理】免费用户核心使用流程多处中断
units.target: [Stability - Resolved] Frequent Disruptions in Free User Core Usage Flows

units.source: 测试中发现免费用户登录后VPN无法正常启动、切换账号后节点列表为空、计时器不显示等问题，均源于台湾遗留的会话状态管理缺陷。相关问题已完成排查，修复正在测试环境验证中。
units.target: Testing revealed multiple issues such as VPN not starting normally after login, empty VPN node list upon switching accounts, and timers not displaying. All these were due to session state management defects left over from Taiwan. The related problems have been thoroughly investigated and are currently being tested in the test environment.

units.source: 【运维·规划中】节点离线误报频繁——告警系统待优化
units.target: [Operations & Planning - In Progress] Frequent False Alarms for VPN node Offline — Alert System Needs Optimization

units.source: 当前系统对每次探测失败均发送告警，导致大量误报干扰运维判断。新方案将在发送通知前自动多次核验，并附带节点负载数据，区分真实故障与短暂波动。方案本阶段内启动开发。
units.target: The current system sends alerts every time a probe fails, leading to frequent false alarms that interfere with operations. A new solution will automatically verify multiple times before sending notifications and include VPN node load data, distinguishing between real faults and temporary fluctuations. Development of this solution is scheduled for the next phase.

units.source: 第2阶段于4月13日启动，以QA全量回归测试结果为基线，系统性清理遗留缺陷。本阶段最直观的成果是版本迭代速度：自第1阶段交付的v2.0.0起，团队已完成多轮修复迭代，应用稳定性、启动速度与流畅度均有明显提升。
units.target: Sprint 2 began on April 13th, using the full regression test results from Phase 1 as a baseline. The systematic cleanup of legacy defects was completed during this phase. One of the most noticeable achievements is the speed at which versions are iterated: since v2.0.0 (from Phase 1), the team has completed multiple rounds of fixes and optimizations, resulting in significant improvements to application stability, startup speed, and fluidity.

units.source: 应用此前版本为v1.7.38。第1阶段完成了一次全面架构重写，直接跳升至v2.0.0——这不是常规小版本升级，而是底层代码的系统性重建，因此QA需要覆盖的测试范围远大于普通版本，本阶段发现问题较多属正常预期。v2.0.6相比v2.0.0：崩溃率显著下降、启动速度加快、连接更稳定流畅。每一版均经QA确认改善后方才推进。
units.target: The previous app version was v1.7.38. Sprint 1 delivered a comprehensive architectural rewrite, jumping directly to v2.0.0. This was not a routine minor update, but a systematic rebuild of the underlying code, so QA coverage had to be far broader than for a normal release and the higher number of issues found in this Sprint was expected. Compared with v2.0.0, v2.0.6 has a significantly lower crash rate, faster startup, and more stable, responsive connections. Each version progressed only after QA confirmed the improvements.

本阶段开发团队与台湾、马来西亚两地QA保持高频协作——QA发现问题、开发当天定位修复、发布新版本、QA立即复测，形成快速闭环。

units.target: During this sprint, the development team maintained high-frequency collaboration with QA teams in Taiwan and Malaysia — issues were identified by QA, fixed on the same day, new versions released, and QA immediately retested. The 45 reported issues (30 defects + 15 optimizations) reflect comprehensive test coverage rather than product instability; from v2.0.0 to v2.0.6, six iterations have been completed, each version was only advanced after QA confirmed improvements. Users will experience enhanced performance upon the official release.

After the five-layer protection mechanism is released, bandwidth resources will be concentrated on genuine paying potential users, expected to boost the paying conversion rate by 0.3–0.5 percentage points.

b0001.source: 第2阶段进展报告（第1周）：Arrowfish 发布冲刺

b0003.source: 台湾遗留系统允许同一设备通过多次注册无限重置每日免费额度，并可被模拟器自动批量注册。若不处理，随规模增长，带宽成本将持续被无转化价值的滥用流量侵蚀，付费用户连接质量也随之下降。

b0004.source: 本阶段建立了五层防护机制（验证中）， 正常免费用户不受任何影响，完整享有每日30分钟权益：

b0005.source: 防护层 机制 封堵的滥用行为

b0006.source: ① 设备维度额度 同一设备所有账号共享每日额度，换号不重置 多账号循环重置试用时间

b0007.source: ② 设备绑定 卸载重装后返回原账号，不发放新额度 卸载重装刷新试用资格

b0008.source: ③ 模拟器检测 应用启动时检测模拟器环境，直接拦截注册 模拟器自动批量注册账号工厂

b0009.source: ④ 注册速率限制 每个IP每天最多注册5个新账号 单IP批量注册

b0010.source: ⑤ 单设备账号上限 每台设备最多绑定3个账号 单设备无限注册账号

b0014.source: 免费试用防滥用 （保护转化率） 验证中 设备维度额度限制 + 注册速率限制，测试验证中

b0015.source: 免费用户连接流程 修复中 计时器、会话重置、试用时长计算等问题修复推进中
